en.title: You Received a Tax Notice: What Should You Do?
en.directAnswer: Do not ignore a tax notice and do not pay money just because someone tells you to. First verify that the notice is genuine, identify the legal section, note the deadline, collect the return and supporting records, and understand what NBR is asking. Get professional help if the notice involves an assessment, penalty, audit or major mismatch.

en.lawMeaning:
The legal effect depends on the exact notice section and facts. This guide must not pretend every notice is the same.

This page gives a general route. A person’s exact rights can change because of facts, documents, deadlines, legal status, court orders or later amendments.
steps: Collect bank, income, TDS and tax-payment records.
Submit through the correct channel and keep proof.
evidence: Relevant official notices, receipts, and correspondence
en.simpleExample: A taxpayer gets a message asking for payment to a personal mobile number. They should verify through NBR channels before sending any money.
en.specialistTrigger: Assessment; penalty; search/audit; large mismatch; appeal deadline; suspected fake notice.
